decisions.reason: Company/resource list; current issues propose websites without a role or application details. Reviewed evidence: https://github.com/ad-si/awesome-fp-jobs/issues/9. README lists and contribution tasks are not issue-based vacancy evidence.

README/website job list, not an issue-based vacancy board. The six open indexed issues reviewed on 2026-11-23 were maintenance, bug, roadmap and feature requests, e.g. https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/issues/449 and https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/issues/316. Contribution tasks do not qualify as public job evidence.

Job-board software; current issues request API and RSS features. Reviewed evidence: https://github.com/cncf/gitjobs/issues/394. README lists and contribution tasks are not issue-based vacancy evidence.

Company directory; issues request columns and directory additions, not individual vacancies. Reviewed evidence: https://github.com/danielbayerlein/remote-jobs-germany/issues/57. README lists and contribution tasks are not issue-based vacancy evidence.

Freelance-resource directory; current issue proposes invoicing tools, not a vacancy. Reviewed evidence: https://github.com/engineerapart/TheRemoteFreelancer/issues/177. README lists and contribution tasks are not issue-based vacancy evidence.

Company directory; current issues request tag normalization and typo corrections. Reviewed evidence: https://github.com/italiaremote/awesome-italia-remote/issues/401. README lists and contribution tasks are not issue-based vacancy evidence.

Job-board resource directory; issues propose sites and request contributors. Reviewed evidence: https://github.com/neutraltone/awesome-development-jobs/issues/22. README lists and contribution tasks are not issue-based vacancy evidence.
Company directory; current issue requests website links. Reviewed evidence: https://github.com/remote-es/remotes/issues/192. README lists and contribution tasks are not issue-based vacancy evidence.

Company directory; current issue requests repairs to company-profile files. Reviewed evidence: https://github.com/remoteintech/remote-jobs/issues/2295. README lists and contribution tasks are not issue-based vacancy evidence.
